meta.title: Pebble Keep
meta.logline: Merge stone golems on a tiny garden board to stop a comedic snail horde from reaching the keep gate, in one-thumb runs of about three minutes.
meta.subgenre: merge tower defense with renovation meta

segments: lapsed tower-defense fans who want short sessions

comparables.title: Rush Royale
borrow: merge two identical units to climb tiers
change: merges keep the family (deterministic), only the spawn is random
portrait one-thumb board instead of a split battlefield

comparables.title: Royal Match
borrow: one star per win spent on visible renovation tasks
short, fast levels with a clear end
change: we restore a garden keep that also unlocks golem families, so the meta feeds the core
bonus sort puzzles replace rescue mini-levels as reward beats

comparables.title: Kingdom Rush
comparables.change: no build menus or placement slots: merging is the only upgrade decision

pillars: One thumb, three minutes: every run fits a queue at the coffee shop
Every merge is a visible power spike
Readable chaos: 30 golems and 40 snails must stay legible on a 5.4-inch phone
The keep grows with you: every win changes something you can see

player_fantasy: You are the young keeper of a crumbling garden keep, waking stone golems and fusing them into ever mightier guardians to hold off a slow but endless army of mischievous snails.

verbs.description: Spend pebbles to wake a tier-1 golem on a random empty cell.
Drag a golem onto an identical golem to fuse them into the next tier.
In Rune Sort bonus levels, tap a tube then a target tube to move the top runes.

mechanics.name: Spawn from a shuffled bag
rules: Spawn places a tier-1 golem on a random empty cell; it is disabled when the board is full or pebbles are short.
The family is drawn from a shuffled bag holding each of the 5 deck families once; the bag refills when empty (no long droughts).
Spawn cost starts at spawn_cost_base and rises by spawn_cost_step per spawn in the run, up to spawn_cost_cap.

parameters.note: Enough for two spawns before the first kill.
Lets the first spawn happen within 2 s of wave 1.
Pushes players toward merging instead of filling the board.

feedback: golem drops in with a dust puff and a stone clack
Spawn button pulses once when it becomes affordable
mechanics.mobile_notes: Spawn button bottom-centre, at least 88x88 pt, reachable by either thumb; no other control in the bottom 120 pt.

mechanics.name: Merge-two upgrade
rules: Dropping a golem on another of the same family and tier merges them into one golem of tier + 1 on the target cell.
Tier 7 is the maximum; tier-7 golems cannot merge.
Dropping on an invalid target returns the golem to its cell with no penalty.

parameters.note: Below 2.0 a merge trades raw DPS for a free cell; far below that the trade feels bad and players stop merging (confirm in playtests).
5 x 6 board; 36 cells breaks readability on small phones.

feedback: merge burst particles in the family colour
clack pitch rises one semitone per tier
light haptic tick on merge, medium on tier 5+
mobile_notes: Drag starts after 6 px of movement
the held golem renders 40 pt above the finger so the thumb never hides the target cell

mechanics.name: Snail path defense
rules: Snails crawl along a fixed path around the board toward the keep gate.
Golems auto-attack the snail nearest the gate within their range.
A snail reaching the gate costs 1 heart (the wave-10 boss costs 3); at 0 hearts the run is lost.
Each defeated snail drops pebbles_per_snail pebbles.

parameters.note: 10 waves of about 18 s each gives the 3-minute run.

feedback: snails pop with a comedic squish and drop glinting pebbles that fly to the counter
the gate shakes and a heart cracks when a snail gets through
mechanics.mobile_notes: The path stays outside the board so fingers never cover enemies; the gate sits top-centre, away from the thumb.

mechanics.name: Rune Sort bonus level
rules: Every 5th level is a Rune Sort bonus: no hearts, no snails, only a generous move limit.
Tap a tube, then a target: the top run of same-colour runes moves onto an empty tube or a matching top, as many as fit.
Solved when every non-empty tube holds 4 runes of one colour; leftover moves add bonus runes.

parameters.note: About 2x the solver minimum keeps the level a reward beat.

feedback: runes glow and chime when a tube completes
completed tubes cork with a satisfying pop
mechanics.mobile_notes: Tubes in one row of up to 7, each at least 44 pt wide; tap-tap instead of drag to support one-handed play.

loops.name: Spawn, merge, defend
loops.description: Kills pay pebbles, pebbles buy spawns, spawns create merge opportunities, merges create power spikes that kill faster.

steps.action: tap Spawn to wake a tier-1 golem
drag a golem onto an identical golem to merge
steps.reward: a stronger golem and a merge burst

steps.action: watch golems auto-attack the snail wave

loops.name: Restore the keep
loops.description: Stars become visible renovation; completed areas unlock golem families, which make the core loop richer.

steps.action: win levels to earn stars and coins
spend stars on keep restoration tasks
steps.reward: a restored piece of the keep and a short story beat

steps.action: upgrade golem families with coins and runes

loops.name: Rune Sort breather
loops.description: Every 5th level swaps tension for a calm sort puzzle that pays the material for upgrades.

steps.action: reach a 5th level and enter Rune Sort
spend runes on a family upgrade

loops.name: Second chance
loops.description: One optional continue per run, by rewarded ad or a fixed gem price shown up front.

steps.action: choose: watch an ad, pay 9 gems, or accept the loss

loops.name: Snail Rally weekend
loops.description: Weekend collection event: shells from every run fill a progress track with odds-disclosed chests.

steps.action: play any level during the weekend

difficulty.model: sawtooth: 9-level ramp, hard level every 10th (period 10); Rune Sort every 5th level is a reward beat

dda.trigger: 2 consecutive losses on the same level
dda.adjustment: snail HP -8% on the next attempt, at most 2 steps (-16%)
dda.bounds: never on the first attempt of a hard level; never linked to spending

steps.goal: see the merged golem pop the first wave
steps.teaches: merging is the source of power

steps.goal: win level 1 and place the first star in the keep

hud: Spawn button bottom-centre in the thumb zone
accessibility: colour-blind-safe family colours plus unique silhouettes and tier pips
reduced-motion toggle (disables screen shake and flashes)

art_direction.style: chunky hand-painted 2D, soft dark outlines, top-down 3/4 view, silhouettes readable at 64 px

audio_direction.music: light folk-orchestral loop, 100-110 BPM, ukulele and pizzicato strings; an intensity layer fades in for waves 8-10
audio_direction.sfx: stone clacks for merges rising in pitch by tier, comedic squish for snail pops, soft wooden UI ticks

iap.contents: removes interstitials; rewarded ads stay optional
28-day Keep Pass premium track: cosmetic skins, coins, runes

rewarded.reward: revive with 1 heart, once per run

pass.note: cosmetics and resources only; no exclusive power

ethics: No interstitials before level 10 or 20 minutes of cumulative play, and never during a run
Every chest shows its drop odds before it is opened; no paid random boxes
No fake countdowns or false scarcity in offers
Revive price is fixed and shown before the choice; never escalates within a run
Players identified as minors by the age gate get non-personalised ads and no targeted offers
Difficulty adjustment never depends on spending

liveops.cadence: Snail Rally every weekend; 28-day Keep Pass seasons; 10 new levels every 2 weeks after soft launch

events.reward: shells fill a milestone track with odds-disclosed chests

must: deterministic sim core with seeded spawn bag
spawn, merge and snail waves with 3 golem families
10 handmade levels and 2 Rune Sort bonus levels
results screen with stars and coins
scripted playthrough and perf gate on a low-tier Android device

risks.risk: Merge tower defense is crowded, so a me-too pitch fails creative tests and CPI is high.
risks.mitigation: Lead every creative with the visible keep renovation and the snail humour; run a 5-creative CPI test before the slice.

risks.risk: Random spawns feel unfair and cause rage quits.
risks.mitigation: Shuffled bag spawning (no droughts); bot runs report the worst 5% of spawn sequences.

risks.risk: 30 golems and 40 snails become unreadable on small phones.
risks.mitigation: Silhouette and tier-pip rules in the style bible; visual gate on a 5.4-inch screenshot set.

risks.risk: AI-generated art drifts off style across batches.
risks.mitigation: Style lock with reference images; nothing ships without an approved manifest entry.

kill_criteria: Prototype: fewer than 6 of 10 persona playtests choose a second run unprompted after two iterations
Soft launch: D1 below 0.30 after two FTUE iterations
Creative test: best of 5 creatives misses the CPI ceiling set in the soft-launch plan
